title: CFA lane 6: derivatives, alternatives and portfolio management
mission: Curate atomic, reusable derivatives, alternatives and portfolio relationships in closed form: forward/future/swap pricing identities, option payoff and bound arithmetic, real-asset and fund arithmetic, portfolio return/risk, CAPM/SML and performance ratios, each with explicit contract, timing and market-scope conventions. Closed-form arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no trading chain required.
priorities: Forward and futures pricing from spot, carry and convenience with stated compounding and timing
Swap fixed-rate and value identities in closed form with stated notional and timing
Option payoff profiles (long/short call/put) and put-call parity with stated exercise and timing
Option price bounds (American/European, with and without carry) as guarded records with stated scope
Real estate and private-equity arithmetic: NOI/cap rates, fee drag, DPI/TVPI/IRR-definitional multiples
Portfolio expected return and variance from weights, variances and covariances with stated scope
CAPM/SML, beta decomposition and required-return forms by reference to lane 3 (no duplicate CAPM record)
Performance ratios: Sharpe, Treynor, Jensen alpha, information ratio and Sortino forms with stated benchmarks
boundaries: This lane owns derivatives/alternatives/portfolio arithmetic; QM, statements, corporate, equity and fixed-income records belong to lanes 1-5.
Do not resubmit the 14 covered TVM-family IDs as new coverage; record overlaps instead (see curator brief).
Black-Scholes and any normal-CDF form is out of engine reach: defer with exact sources, never approximate the CDF.
Binomial option pricing beyond tiny closed-form cases and all iterative calibration are deferred with sources.
CAPM as a formula record lives in lane 3; this lane references it and curates only portfolio-specific applications with distinct math and sources.
starter_sources: Owner excerpt packet for this lane (discovery leads with exact PDF locators; corroborate every record against a directly inspected accessible source).
A public derivatives/portfolio text with the same formulas (for example OpenStax Principles of Finance); record exact book, edition and section, never cite a root URL as evidence.
special_checks: Contract specifications (underlying, expiry, exercise style, settlement, margin/collateral scope) are part of every derivatives record.
Bounds records carry the exact no-arbitrage assumptions and state what violation would mean; no trading advice.
Performance ratios state the benchmark, frequency annualization and gross/net-of-fees basis explicitly.
Test expiry/intrinsic-value boundaries and zero-volatility or zero-excess-return degeneracies explicitly.
integration_expectation: New meanings (forward_price, option_payoff, portfolio_variance, sharpe_ratio and similar) require extension; portfolio sums fit the engine via sum over index families once meanings exist. Long/short signs are part of the record. Never relabel a payoff as a price or a ratio as a rate to force execution.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent derivatives/alternatives/portfolio readings inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
